<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1;
mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><span style="text-indent: -18pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">&nbsp; &nbsp; The proposed development, by reason of its prominent siting and the introduction of a two storey semi-detached
pair, would result in a bulky and unsympathetic development which would fail to re</span><span style="text-indent: -18pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">spond positively to the local context in terms of design,
siting, and prevailing character</span><span style="text-indent: -18pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">. The proposed design is of poor
quality and fails to incorporate any features of architectural merit that are
distinct within the locality resulting in an unduly obtrusive, poor quality and unsympathetic development that would
appear overly prominent and incongruous within the streetscene. In the absence of
a streetscene plan, there is insufficient information available for the Local
Planning Authority to properly assess the height of the proposal in context. As
such, the proposed development is contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3.D(1), D3.D(11) and D3.D(12) of The
London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1
of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the Adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;

bold">The proposed development is located within surface water flood zone 2 and 3a
and in the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment, it has not been
demonstrated that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of
flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding
elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI 12
of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012)
and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local
